codeql_results.message: XML parsing depends on a [user-provided value](1) without guarding against uncontrolled entity expansion.

findings.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Recursive Entity Expansion in XML Processing
findings.description: XML parsing occurs without guarding against uncontrolled entity expansion (XXE) at line 13. This could allow attackers to cause denial of service or extract sensitive data through crafted XML inputs.
findings.remediation_code:
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
parser = ET.XMLParser(resolve_entities=False)
root = ET.fromstring(xml_data, parser=parser)
findings.remediation_description: Disable entity resolution in XML parser to prevent XXE attacks. Use XMLParser with resolve_entities=False to mitigate recursive entity expansion risks.

report.recommendation: Implement XML parser with entity resolution disabled to mitigate suspected XXE vulnerability. Validate input XML structure and consider using a whitelist validation schema.
